world.title: A North Carolina couple noticed their new home's kitchen floor dipping within weeks of moving in in 2016, then sued the builder years later; an appeals court has rejected their defective-construction
world.summary: A North Carolina couple discovered a significant dip in their kitchen floor shortly after moving into their new home in 2016. They contacted the builder, who attempted repairs. Years later, the couple sued for defective construction. However, an appeals court has rejected their claims, ruling against the couple in their pursuit of compensation for the issue.

world.title: Saudi Arabia says it intercepts three Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh
world.summary: The Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting and destroying three ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh on Saturday. This incident marks the second Houthi attack on the Saudi capital within a few days, following a missile strike on the city's tallest skyscraper on Thursday. The coalition continues to combat the Iran-aligned Houthis amid ongoing tensions in the region.

world.title: Araqchi says Iran wants diplomacy to end war, Trump says terms unacceptable
world.summary: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi expressed hope for a diplomatic resolution to the ongoing conflict with the United States. In contrast, US President Donald Trump stated that while Iran seeks a deal, the terms proposed are unacceptable to him. The comments highlight the ongoing tensions and differing perspectives on negotiations between the two nations.

business.title: Tata Trusts Chair Noel Tata fires stronger salvo at Tata Sons board in new letter
business.summary: Noel Tata has expressed serious concerns about decisions made by Tata Sons, advocating for increased transparency. He questions the validity of N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as executive chairman. In a letter, Tata requests recordings from a key board meeting held on September 17 and seeks clarification on the company's communications with the Reserve Bank of India regarding future listings.

business.title: Tata Steel closes in on APL Apollo buyout; ArcelorMittal also in fray
business.summary: Tata Steel is pursuing a buyout of APL Apollo, aiming to acquire the entire 28% promoter stake. A successful open offer could result in a total transaction valued at approximately $3.5 billion. ArcelorMittal is also competing for the acquisition, indicating significant interest in APL Apollo among major steel producers in India. The outcome remains to be seen.

business.title: Oil Prices Caught Between a Looming Glut and Middle East Turmoil
business.summary: Global oil markets are facing a potential supply surplus as Middle Eastern production increases. However, geopolitical tensions and varying demand forecasts, along with European gas shortages, are maintaining price support. Recent agency reports indicate expectations of oversupply, while oil prices have remained stable amid ongoing conflicts and stalled diplomatic efforts in the region, creating a complex market environment.

technology.title: Where is Mandy’s house in GTA 6? Where to find her location and what happens after Chapter 1
technology.summary: In GTA 6, players can discover small story moments while exploring Leonida. One notable character is Mandy, whom Jason meets early in Chapter 1. Although her appearance may seem brief, players can find her house and learn more about her character as they progress through the game. These interactions enhance the overall gaming experience for curious players.

technology.title: Actor Who Plays Mandy in GTA 6 Excitedly Speaks Out After Character Goes Viral
technology.summary: Lexie Shoaibi, the actress portraying Mandy in the newly released GTA 6, expressed her excitement after the character gained popularity online. Mandy is introduced early in the game, and Shoaibi, an American actress, shared her thoughts on the character's reception. The game's official release has sparked significant interest, leading to discussions about Mandy's role among players.

technology.title: Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular (2026) drops to lowest price
technology.summary: The Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular (2026) is now available at its lowest price on Amazon, following a significant discount. The 42 mm model is priced at $429, while the 46 mm model costs $479. This smartwatch features call services and offers full integration with Apple iPhone smartphones, enhancing connectivity for users.

sports.title: Hazlewood backs 'great leader' Cummins, insists no knowledge of ball tampering
sports.summary: Fast bowler Josh Hazlewood defended captain Pat Cummins, calling him a "great leader" amid controversy. He refuted claims made by Cameron Bancroft and Usman Khawaja regarding ball tampering, asserting he had no knowledge of such actions. Hazlewood also stated he would reconsider his position on the team if Cummins were not the captain, emphasizing his support for leadership.

sports.title: India vs New Zealand Live Score 1st Test: Rahul, Padikkal keep New Zealand at bay
sports.summary: In the 1st Test between India and New Zealand, India scored 190 runs for 1 wicket after 53 overs, chasing New Zealand's total of 368. KL Rahul and Devdutt Padikkal played crucial roles in keeping New Zealand's bowlers at bay. A notable front no-ball from Duffy contributed to India's progress as they approached the 200-run mark.

sports.title: 'Deserved justice': Why India boycotted presentation ceremony after Pakistan won Asia Cup - Explained
sports.summary: The Indian blind cricket team boycotted the men's Asia Cup presentation ceremony in Dhaka after Pakistan was declared champions, despite the final being washed out without any play. The team's action was a protest against the decision, which they deemed unfair. The incident highlights ongoing tensions between the two nations in the context of sports and competition.

health.title: Cases of seasonal ailments rise as weather changes
health.summary: Prayagraj is experiencing a rise in seasonal ailments, including viral fever, conjunctivitis, allergies, and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), as temperatures and humidity fluctuate. Local doctors attribute this increase to pollution and cold weather conditions. Hospitals and clinics are reporting a significant uptick in patients seeking treatment for these conditions amid the changing climate.

health.title: Revolution Medicines Highlights Strong 12-Month Overall Survival Rate for Lead Cancer Drug Regimen
health.summary: Revolution Medicines, Inc. reported positive results from its Phase 1/2 RMC-GI-102 study of Rasonque (daraxonrasib) combined with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel (GnP). The regimen is being evaluated as a first-line treatment for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC). The company highlighted a strong overall survival rate over 12 months, indicating potential effectiveness in this challenging cancer type.

health.title: India unveils first indigenous H5N1 vaccine to protect chickens from bird flu
health.summary: India has introduced its first indigenous vaccine against the H5N1 strain of bird flu, aimed at protecting poultry. Union agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced the vaccine, which is priced at Rs 1-2 per dose. This development is expected to enhance biosecurity in the poultry sector and mitigate the impact of bird flu outbreaks in the country.

science.title: Petrology Journal Guide: Scope, Metrics & APC
science.summary: The Petrology Journal Guide provides a comprehensive overview of petrology journals, focusing on the Journal of Petrology's scope, Oxford publishing models, article processing charges (APC), and indexing. It highlights the significance of these journals in studying the origin, composition, structure, and geological occurrence of igneous, metamorphic, and sedimentary rocks within the broader context of earth and planetary sciences.

science.title: Big supermoon energy this winter in Middle Tennessee
science.summary: Middle Tennessee will experience three full supermoons this winter, starting with the Beaver Moon on Tuesday. Named for seasonal activities, the Beaver, Cold, and Wolf supermoons will occur from Thanksgiving week into the new year. These celestial events will provide opportunities for stargazers to observe the moons at their closest point to Earth, enhancing their visibility.

science.title: Full Beaver Supermoon November 2026
science.summary: The Beaver Moon in November 2026 will mark the first of three consecutive supermoons. Its increased tidal pull may cause water to inundate low-lying coastal roads and sidewalks, particularly during the Thanksgiving period. This astronomical event is expected to attract attention due to its potential impact on coastal areas, highlighting the significance of lunar phases on tidal patterns.
